# اِسْتَمْرَأْتِ (istamraʔti) /is.tam.raʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَمْرَأَ (istamraʔa)
# اِسْتَمْرَأَتْ (istamraʔat) /is.t
